name: Requests
tagline: Catches every question the assistant could not close

roadmap.note: Next after Contacts. Shares the assistant widget rather than adding a second one.

marketing.summary: When the assistant cannot answer, the conversation should not end there. Requests turns that moment into a captured lead or a ticket: the customer leaves their details in the same chat window, you get an email, and the thread is waiting in your dashboard.
marketing.audience: Businesses where an unanswered question is a lost sale, and anyone who currently loses enquiries in a shared inbox.

features.title: One widget, not two
features.body: Lead capture, feedback and support requests all happen inside the assistant bubble your customers already use. No second popup fighting for attention.

features.title: Handoff when it matters
features.body: You decide when the assistant offers a handoff: after a failed answer, on specific topics, or whenever the customer asks for a person.

features.title: Forms without a form builder
features.body: Choose which details to collect - name, email, phone, a note - and the assistant asks for them conversationally.

features.title: Everything lands in Contacts
features.body: Each request creates or updates a contact, so the same person's history stays together across modules.

faq.a: No, and deliberately so. It is a capture-and-reply inbox. If you already run a helpdesk, forward to it instead.

faq.q: Do I need the assistant to use this?
faq.a: Yes. Requests lives inside the assistant widget rather than shipping a second script for your site.
